newsitem.title: UK: UK meal and feeds lower, buyers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: UK meal and feeds lower, buyers sidelined.

text.p: Lower UK meals and feeds prices on Thursday, following the easier close in Chicago, failed to tempt buyers off the sidelines.
High protein soymeal was as much as four stg down from the mill and stores but buyers would not move.
"Our biggest achievement today has been to finish the crossword" said one broker.
Rapemeal offers were one to two stg down while sunflower meals and corn gluten feed pellets were unchanged.
